# atproto_tangled_knot_member (Resource)

Adds an account to a knot, letting it create repositories there. The provider's account must own the knot.

The knot must advertise the `knot-acl` capability.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atproto_tangled_knot_member" "bob" {
  knot    = atproto_tangled_knot.home.domain
  subject = data.atproto_account.bob.did
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `knot` (String) Domain of the knot.
- `subject` (String) DID of the account.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifying attributes joined with `/`: `knot/subject`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# knot/subject
tofu import atproto_tangled_knot_member.bob knot.example.com/did:plc:bob
```
